How we work

Four steps, no surprises

1

Scope

A short paid discovery. You leave with a spec, a timeline and a fixed price — whether or not you build with us.

2

Design

Clickable prototype before a line of production code. You approve how it looks and how it feels.

3

Build

Two-week sprints with a working build in your hands at the end of each one. No black box.

4

Ship

We handle store review, launch and the first months of iteration while real users arrive.
